verdict.rationale: Mercury documents card limits, spend controls, and approvals in its dashboard, and lets users manage spending limits through the API. A community user also reports setting individual limits on hundreds of virtual cards. That suggests an admin can adjust card limits themselves. Nothing in the evidence, however, describes a self-service screen for requesting a transaction limit increase, either from Mercury or within an approval flow. Missing for 10: a documented self-service limit-increase request screen or workflow, how such a request is approved and routed, and any hands-on corroboration of requesting an increase.
